svg.title: One request, three processes, one cache
svg.desc: A chat request with a 2,999-token prompt crosses the tokenizer manager, the scheduler, and the detokenizer, drawn as three machines on one bench. The scheduler finds 2,998 tokens in the radix cache, prefills one, and the first token arrives in 34.0 ms. Below, three versions of the same system prompt: unchanged, with a request id at the start, and with the id at the end. Bar length is prompt tokens, green is cached, rose is recomputed, and tower height is median time to first token.
svg.text: ONE REQUEST · ROUND 3 OF THE STABLE SYSTEM PROMPT

g.text: THE PROMPT AS THE RADIX CACHE SAW IT
2,998 cached tokens · system prompt and chat template

svg.text: THE SAME SYSTEM PROMPT THREE WAYS · MEDIAN OF ROUNDS 2 TO 5 OR 1 TO 5
